keyChanges.title: AI5 Chip Taped Out, Samsung Taylor Fab Equipment Ceremony April 24
keyChanges.description: Tesla announced AI5 chip tape-out on April 15, 2026 - key milestone sending final design to foundry. First silicon samples expected later 2026, high-volume production mid-2027. Samsung holding equipment installation ceremony at Taylor, Texas foundry on April 24, 2026, kicking off final run-up to mass production of AI5 and AI6 chips on 2nm process. AI5 dual-sourced at TSMC Arizona and Samsung Texas facilities.

keyChanges.title: 60 Cybercab Units Spotted at Giga Texas Mid-April
keyChanges.description: Drone footage captured approximately 60 Cybercab units at Giga Texas on April 13-17, 2026, up from 50+ units earlier. 14 units spotted on April 17 without steering wheels, indicating regulatory-ready production models. Mass production ramping successfully following April launch target.

keyChanges.title: Belgium Expected Mid-May, EU-Wide Vote Possible May-June 2026
keyChanges.description: Belgium authorities signaled they will recognize Dutch approval within ~30 days (mid-May 2026 target), making it the fastest EU follower. Germany (KBA) expected to move in late spring (May-June 2026, 4-8 weeks post-April 10). EU-wide vote at Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles (TCMV) could happen as soon as May/June, automatically extending FSD across entire EU.

keyChanges.title: Shanghai Gigafactory Positioned for Optimus Mass Production
keyChanges.description: Tesla China President Allan Wang Hao announced on April 14, 2026 that Giga Shanghai will play a crucial role in Optimus production. Shanghai planning to ramp six new production lines in 2026 across vehicles, robots, energy storage, and battery manufacturing. Production targeted before end of 2026 with eventual capacity of 1 million robots/year. Over 1,000 Gen 3 units already deployed across Tesla facilities.

keyChanges.title: Optimus Job Postings Increase to 100+ Active Roles
keyChanges.description: Tesla posted well over 100 Optimus-related job openings across U.S. facilities in April 2026, representing expansion in robotics hiring. Roles span full product lifecycle including Robotics Software Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, Mechanical Integration Engineers, and AI Engineers focused on world modeling and video generation.

keyChanges.title: BREAKING: Robotaxi Service Launches in Houston & Dallas (April 18)
keyChanges.description: Tesla announced April 18, 2026 that unsupervised Robotaxi service is now live in Dallas and Houston, Texas. Fully autonomous rides with no safety driver are now operating in 3 Texas cities: Austin, Dallas, and Houston. Tracker data shows 35 Cybercabs in test fleet, 29% of Austin rides now unsupervised (20 of 69 in last 7 days), with 2,053 total trips recorded covering 7,271 miles. Part of H1 2026 expansion to 7 cities including Phoenix, Miami, Orlando, Tampa, and Las Vegas.

trends: AI5 tape-out marks major milestone; production timeline now clearer: mid-2027 for high volume
Cybercab production ramp accelerating - 60 units milestone with steering-wheel-free models appearing
MAJOR: Robotaxi service expansion to Houston & Dallas marks commercial deployment acceleration

keyChanges.title: Netherlands FSD Officially Approved April 10, Subscriptions Live
keyChanges.description: RDW issued formal type approval for FSD Supervised on April 10, 2026. Netherlands becomes first EU market to authorize FSD on public roads. Subscriptions launched at €99/month. EU-wide approval via mutual recognition expected summer 2026. Germany, France, Belgium, Spain, Italy rollout anticipated by summer.

keyChanges.title: Cortex 2.0 Supercomputer Phase 1 Online, Digital Optimus Announced
keyChanges.description: Tesla's Cortex 2.0 supercomputer Phase 1 (250MW) came online in April 2026, providing AI training for Optimus fleet learning. Full 500MW capacity expected mid-2026. Digital Optimus (codename: Macrohard) announced March 11 - AI system combining physical Optimus robots with Grok-based AI for complete automation.

keyChanges.title: April Mass Production Started On Schedule
keyChanges.description: Cybercab mass production began in April 2026 as planned. Validation testing across multiple US cities (Austin, San Jose, Chicago, DC) completed successfully. Production lines operational targeting hundreds of units weekly.

keyChanges.title: AI6 Timeline Stable at Q3-Q4 2027
keyChanges.description: AI6 chip timeline remains Q3-Q4 2027 for mass production. Post-silicon validation stage ongoing. No new delays reported since March updates.

keyChanges.title: Optimus Job Postings Stable at 110+
keyChanges.description: 110+ Optimus-related job postings remain active across robotics software, manufacturing, AI, and mechanical design roles at Austin and Fremont facilities.

trends: FSD EU rollout velocity post-Netherlands approval - watch Belgium, Germany next

keyChanges.title: Samsung 2nm Yields Improve to 60%, Production Confirmed for H2 2027
keyChanges.description: Samsung achieved 60% yield on 2nm process (3x improvement from 20%). Confirmed AI6 chip production at Texas facility starting H2 2027. Tesla planning to double orders to 40,000 wafers/month.

keyChanges.title: 35 Units at Giga Texas, Intensive Crash Testing Underway
keyChanges.description: Drone footage shows 35 Cybercab units with 12 simultaneously in crash testing facility. SXSW showcase demonstrated production-ready vehicle. Testing expanded to multiple US cities. April mass production target on track.

keyChanges.title: Netherlands Approval Delayed to April 10, EU Rollout Progressing
keyChanges.description: Netherlands approval delayed from March 20 to April 10. Belgium signals approval within 30 days of Dutch approval. EU-wide rollout anticipated for summer 2026. Japan released first public FSD demo video in Tokyo.

keyChanges.title: Summer 2026 Production Start Confirmed at Abundance Summit
keyChanges.description: Musk confirmed at Abundance Summit (March 12) that Optimus V3 production begins Summer 2026 at Fremont. Model S/X ending Q2 2026 to free production lines. First commercial customers expected late 2026.
